verdict.rationale: The closest match is Pulumi Policies. These are guardrail rules defined in code and applied automatically to resources, and their violations now surface in pull request comments and checks. That amounts to rules producing automatic actions on PR and deployment events. The Automation API and VCS integrations could also be wired to events, but only with custom code. Missing for 10: a documented event-trigger/rule engine (e.g. webhooks or deployment triggers on events), user-configurable rule→action mappings beyond policy enforcement, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
